I'll work through this systematically, checking each major signature passage against the draft.

**Opening fog paragraph check:** The fog paragraph is largely preserved verbatim, but one small detail is dropped: "wheezing by the firesides of their wards" after the Greenwich pensioners line. Minor.

**"The raw afternoon is rawest" paragraph:** The draft drops "appropriate ornament for the threshold of a leaden-headed old corporation" — this is part of Dickens's satirical rhetoric about Temple Bar, and "is densest" becomes "densest" (dropping "is"). Minor.

**"On such an afternoon, if ever" paragraph:** The draft drops the rhetorical "if ever, the Lord High Chancellor ought to be sitting here—as here he is" and "ought to be—as here they are" and "ought to be—as are they not?" constructions. These parallel rhetorical ironies ("ought to be...as here they are") are a signature stylistic device, the sardonic "as if reality confirms absurdity" structure. The draft flattens this to plain declaratives. Also dropped: "running...with serious faces, as players might" is slightly compressed. The "Well may the court be dim, with wasting candles here and there; well may the fog hang heavy in it, as if it would never get out" anaphora is cut entirely.

**Jarndyce and Jarndyce joke paragraph:** "It has been death to many, but it is a joke in the profession" — present. But the passage about "Good things have been said about it by blue-nosed, bulbous-shoed old benchers in select port-wine committee after dinner in hall. Articled clerks have been in the habit of fleshing their legal wit upon it" — entirely absent. Also "a pleasantry that particularly tickled the maces, bags, and purses" is dropped.

**Corruption paragraph:** "In trickery, evasion, procrastination, spoliation, botheration, under false pretences of all sorts, there are influences that can never come to good" — the draft converts this to "Trickery, evasion...never come to good," losing the specific syntactic force of "there are influences that can never come to good."

**"Leaving this address (delivered like a sepulchral message) ringing in the rafters of the roof"** — this atmospheric, signature descriptive clause is absent in the draft, which just says "Dropping, he is seen no more."
